title: Anton Reicha: The String Quartets
author: Ron Drummond
why: Anton Reicha was an exact contemporary of Beethoven and his own highly individual and ambitious conception of what instrumental music could be after Haydn, but that music was largely forgotten, and most accounts of Reicha fail to depict what's interesting about it. Drummond turned me on to Reicha almost a decade ago, and how I am obsessed.

title: The String Theory
author: David Foster Wallace
why: Pro tennis, experienced courtside, is its own aesthetic universe, which David Foster Wallace captures better than other writers I'm aware of.

title: Federer as Religious Experience
author: David Foster Wallace
why: More good tennis writing by DFW.

title: Kenny Felder's Essays
author: Kenny Felder
why: Clever essays on philosophy that combine extreme clarity and insight ("oh yeah, that's right, that's exactly how I'd put it if I could!") with a sort of outsider perspective.
